visual_logic: Highlights the flat, wide, duck-like beak lined with miniature razor-sharp, interlocking triangular teeth.

The jaw has a smooth, matte leather-like finish in pale olive-green tones. The specimen is vertically oriented and perfectly centered in a 1:1 square composition, keeping a strict 25% negative space safety margin. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with soft contact shadows. Illuminated by soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to show the scissor-like cutting line.
